specs.title: API-0151: Delete brand as a non-admin user returns 403

steps.title: Send POST /brands with a unique brand name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new brand's id.
Send DELETE /brands/{brandId} with that id, with the default user's token.
Verify the response status is 403.
Verify the body's message is "Forbidden".

specs.title: API-0148: Admin deletes a brand

steps.title: Send POST /brands with a unique brand name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new brand's id.
Send DELETE /brands/{brandId} with that id, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 204.
Verify GET /brands/{brandId} with that id returns 404.

specs.title: API-0149: Delete brand without a token returns 401

steps.title: Send POST /brands with a unique brand name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new brand's id.
Send DELETE /brands/{brandId} with that id, without an Authorization header.
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's message is "Unauthorized".

specs.title: API-0150: Delete brand with an invalid token returns 401

steps.title: Send POST /brands with a unique brand name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new brand's id.
Send DELETE /brands/{brandId} with that id, with an invalid token.
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's message is "Unauthorized".

specs.title: API-0152: Delete brand with an unknown id returns 404

steps.title: Send DELETE /brands/{brandId} with a well-formed ULID that no brand has, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 404.
Verify the body's message is "Requested item not found".

specs.title: API-0153: Delete brand that a product uses returns 409

steps.title: Send POST /brands with a unique brand name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new brand's id.
Send GET /products and take the first item's category id and product image id.

Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, that category id, the new brand's id as brand_id, that product image id, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, with the admin's token, and take the new product's id.
Send DELETE /brands/{brandId} with the new brand's id, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 409.
Verify the body's success is false and its message is "Seems like this brand is used elsewhere.".
Verify GET /brands/{brandId} with the new brand's id returns 200.

specs.title: API-0130: Get brand returns 200 with the brand

steps.title: Send GET /brands and take the first brand's id, name and slug.
Send GET /brands/{brandId} with that id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's id, name and slug equal the list item's.

specs.title: API-0131: Get brand with an unknown id returns 404

steps.title: Send GET /brands/{brandId} with a well-formed ULID that no brand has.
Verify the response status is 404.
Verify the body's message is "Requested item not found".

specs.title: API-0154: Search brands returns only matching brands

steps.title: Send GET /brands/search with q=forge.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body is a non-empty array and every item's name contains "forge" (case-insensitive).
Verify every item has a non-empty string id, name and slug.

specs.title: API-0155: Search brands with a term shorter than 4 characters matches inside names

steps.title: Send GET /brands/search with q=fle.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body is a non-empty array and every item's name contains "fle" (case-insensitive).

specs.title: API-0156: Search brands with a term no brand matches returns an empty array

steps.title: Send GET /brands/search with q set to a unique term of letters and digits only that no brand has.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body is an empty array.

specs.title: API-0157: Search brands without a term returns the seeded brands

steps.title: Send GET /brands and keep the ids of the seeded brands ForgeFlex Tools and MightyCraft Hardware.
Send GET /brands/search without a q parameter.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body includes both seeded brand ids.

specs.title: API-0119: List brands returns the brands

steps.title: Send GET /brands.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body is a non-empty array.
Verify every item has a non-empty string id, name and slug.

specs.title: API-0144: Partially update brand with an unknown id returns 404

steps.title: Send PATCH /brands/{brandId} with a well-formed ULID that no brand has and a body with only a unique brand name.
Verify the response status is 404.
Verify the body's message is "Requested item not found".

specs.title: API-0141: Partially update brand name returns success and keeps the slug

steps.title: Send POST /brands with a unique brand name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new brand's id and slug.
Send PATCH /brands/{brandId} with that id and a body with only a new unique brand name, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify GET /brands/{brandId} with that id returns the new name and the original slug.

specs.title: API-0142: Partially update brand with a slug outside letters, digits, dashes and underscores returns 422

steps.title: Send POST /brands with a unique brand name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new brand's id.
Send PATCH /brands/{brandId} with that id and a body with only a slug made of a unique slug followed by " x!" (a space and an exclamation mark), with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a slug key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0143: Partially update brand with a name longer than 120 characters returns 422

steps.title: Send POST /brands with a unique brand name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new brand's id.
Send PATCH /brands/{brandId} with that id and a body with only a 121-character name that starts with a unique brand name, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a name key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0145: Partially update brand with another brand's slug returns 409

steps.title: Send POST /brands with a unique brand name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new brand's id and slug.
Send GET /brands and take the slug of a brand other than the new one.
Send PATCH /brands/{brandId} with the new brand's id and a body with only that other slug, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 409.
Verify the body has a slug key with at least one message.
Verify GET /brands/{brandId} with the new brand's id still returns its own slug.

specs.title: API-0120: Create brand returns 201 with the new brand

Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body's name and slug equal the values sent.
Verify the body has a non-empty id.
Verify GET /brands/{brandId} with the new id returns 200 with the same name and slug.

specs.title: API-0128: Create brand ignores fields other than name and slug

steps.title: Send POST /brands with a unique brand name, a unique slug and a description field set to "ignored", with the admin's token, and take the new brand's id.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body has the keys id, name and slug only.
Verify GET /brands/{brandId} with the new id has no description key.

specs.title: API-0326: Add a rental that is a location offer to a cart near Amsterdam gives it a 20% discount

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer true, is_rental true and stock 10, and take the new product's id.
Send POST /carts with lat 52 and lng 5 and take the returned id as the cart's id.
Send POST /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id and a body with the new product's id as product_id and quantity 1.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify GET /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id returns 200 and its only item has discount_percentage 20.
Verify the item's discounted_price equals its product's price × 0.8, rounded to 2 decimals.

specs.title: API-0230: Create cart with an empty body returns 201 and an empty cart

steps.title: Send POST /carts with an empty body.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body's id is a non-empty string.
Verify GET /carts/{cartId} with that id returns 200 with the same id and an empty cart_items.

specs.title: API-0231: Create cart with coordinates stores them on the cart

steps.title: Send POST /carts with lat 52 and lng 5 and take the returned id as the cart's id.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify GET /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id returns 200 with lat numerically equal to 52 and lng numerically equal to 5.

specs.title: API-0251: Update item quantity replaces the quantity of a product in the cart

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false, is_rental false and stock 10, and take the new product's id.
Send POST /carts with an empty body and take the returned id as the cart's id.
Send POST /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id and a body with the new product's id as product_id and quantity 2.
Send PUT /carts/{cartId}/product/quantity with the cart's id and a body with the new product's id as product_id and quantity 5.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's result is "item added or updated".
Verify GET /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id returns 200 and its cart_items has exactly one item, with the new product's id as product_id and quantity 5.

specs.title: API-0252: Update item quantity for a product that isn't in the cart returns 200 and changes nothing

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false, is_rental false and stock 10, and take the new product's id.
Send POST /carts with an empty body and take the returned id as the cart's id.
Send PUT /carts/{cartId}/product/quantity with the cart's id and a body with the new product's id as product_id and quantity 5.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's result is "item added or updated".
Verify GET /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id returns 200 and its cart_items is empty.

specs.title: API-0253: Update item quantity without the required fields returns 422 for each of them

steps.title: Send POST /carts with an empty body and take the returned id as the cart's id.
Send PUT /carts/{cartId}/product/quantity with the cart's id and an empty JSON object as the body.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body's errors has the keys product_id and quantity, each with at least one message.
Verify the body's errors quantity messages include "The quantity field is required.".

specs.title: API-0254: Update item quantity with a non-integer quantity returns 422 and keeps the quantity

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false, is_rental false and stock 10, and take the new product's id.
Send POST /carts with an empty body and take the returned id as the cart's id.
Send POST /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id and a body with the new product's id as product_id and quantity 1.
Send PUT /carts/{cartId}/product/quantity with the cart's id and a body with the new product's id as product_id and quantity 1.5.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body's errors quantity messages include "The quantity field must be an integer.".
Verify GET /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id returns 200 and its only item has quantity 1.

specs.title: API-0255: Update item quantity with quantity 0 returns 422 and keeps the quantity

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.

Send POST /carts with an empty body and take the returned id as the cart's id.
Send POST /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id and a body with the new product's id as product_id and quantity 1.
Send PUT /carts/{cartId}/product/quantity with the cart's id and a body with the new product's id as product_id and quantity 0.

Verify GET /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id returns 200 and its only item has quantity 1.

specs.title: API-0256: Update item quantity with an unknown product id returns 422

specs.title: API-0257: Update item quantity with an unknown cart id returns 404

specs.title: API-0259: Update Thor Hammer's quantity to 2 returns 400 and keeps quantity 1

steps.title: Send GET /products/search with q set to Thor Hammer and take the id of the item whose name is exactly "Thor Hammer".
Send POST /carts with an empty body and take the returned id as the cart's id.
Send POST /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id and a body with Thor Hammer's id as product_id and quantity 1.

Verify the response status is 400.

Verify GET /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id returns 200 and its only item has quantity 1.

specs.title: API-0165: Create category returns 201 with the new category

steps.title: Send POST /categories with a unique category name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new category's id.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body's name and slug equal the values sent.
Verify the body has a non-empty id.
Verify GET /categories/tree/{categoryId} with the new id returns 200 with the same name and slug, a null parent_id and an empty sub_categories.

specs.title: API-0166: Create category with a parent_id creates a sub-category

steps.title: Send POST /categories with a unique category name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new category's id as the parent's id.
Send POST /categories with a unique category name, a unique slug and the parent's id as parent_id, with the admin's token, and take the new category's id.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body's parent_id equals the parent's id.
Verify GET /categories/tree/{categoryId} with the new id returns the parent's id as parent_id.
Verify GET /categories/tree/{categoryId} with the parent's id returns sub_categories with exactly one item, whose id is the new category's id.

specs.title: API-0175: Create category ignores fields other than name, slug and parent_id

steps.title: Send POST /categories with a unique category name, a unique slug and a description field set to "ignored", with the admin's token, and take the new category's id.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body has the keys id, name and slug only.
Verify GET /categories/tree/{categoryId} with the new id has no description key.

specs.title: API-0208: Update category with an unknown id returns 404

steps.title: Send PUT /categories/{categoryId} with a well-formed ULID that no category has and a body with only a unique category name.
Verify the response status is 404.
Verify the body's message is "Requested item not found".

specs.title: API-0209: Update category with an unknown id and an invalid body returns 422

steps.title: Send PUT /categories/{categoryId} with a well-formed ULID that no category has and a body with only a 121-character name that starts with a unique category name.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a name key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0201: Update category returns success and saves the new name and slug

steps.title: Send POST /categories with a unique category name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new category's id.
Send PUT /categories/{categoryId} with that id and a body with a new unique category name and a new unique slug, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify GET /categories/tree/{categoryId} with that id returns the new name and the new slug.

specs.title: API-0202: Update category with a parent_id makes it a sub-category of that parent

steps.title: Send POST /categories with a unique category name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new category's id as the parent's id.
Send POST /categories with a unique category name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new category's id.
Send PUT /categories/{categoryId} with the new category's id and a body with only the parent's id as parent_id, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify GET /categories/tree/{categoryId} with the new category's id returns the parent's id as parent_id.
Verify GET /categories/tree doesn't include the new category's id among its items.

specs.title: API-0203: Update category with a null parent_id makes it a top-level category

steps.title: Send POST /categories with a unique category name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new category's id as the parent's id.
Send POST /categories with a unique category name, a unique slug and the parent's id as parent_id, with the admin's token, and take the new category's id.
Send PUT /categories/{categoryId} with the new category's id and a body with only parent_id set to null, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify GET /categories/tree/{categoryId} with the new category's id returns a null parent_id.
Verify GET /categories/tree includes the new category's id among its items.

specs.title: API-0204: Update category with a name longer than 120 characters returns 422

steps.title: Send POST /categories with a unique category name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new category's id.
Send PUT /categories/{categoryId} with that id and a body with only a 121-character name that starts with a unique category name, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a name key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0205: Update category with a slug outside letters, digits, dashes and underscores returns 422

Verify the body has a slug key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0206: Update category with a name that isn't a string returns 422

steps.title: Send POST /categories with a unique category name and a unique slug, with the admin's token, and take the new category's id.
Send PUT /categories/{categoryId} with that id and a body with only name set to the number 123, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 422.

specs.title: API-0207: Update category with a parent_id that isn't a string returns 422

specs.title: API-0463: Get invoice returns 200 with its lines, payment and totals

stdout.text: [cleanup] User 01m51q42hkv1brhb15dyh3z84y is still in use (409); the hourly re-seed removes it.

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take its access_token.
Send GET /products and take the first item's id as the product's id.
Send POST /carts with an empty body and take the returned id as the cart's id.
Send POST /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id, the product's id as product_id and quantity 2.

Send POST /invoices with that access_token, payment_method "cash-on-delivery", payment_details {}, billing_street "Stephansplatz 1", billing_city "Wien", billing_country "AT" and the cart's id as cart_id, and take the new invoice's id, invoice_number and total.
Send GET /invoices/{invoiceId} with the invoice's id and that access_token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's id and invoice_number equal the invoice's, and its user_id equals the new user's id.
Verify the body's billing_street is "Stephansplatz 1", billing_city is "Wien" and billing_country is "AT".

Verify the body has the keys invoice_date, status, status_message, created_at, subtotal, total, additional_discount_percentage, additional_discount_amount, eco_discount_percentage, eco_discount_amount, invoicelines and payment.
Verify the body has no updated_at and no document key.

Verify invoicelines has exactly one line with the product's id as product_id and quantity 2, whose product has the keys id, name, description, price, co2_rating, is_rental, in_stock, is_eco_friendly, product_image, category and brand.
Verify the body's payment.payment_method is "cash-on-delivery".
Verify the body's subtotal equals the line's quantity times its discounted_price (or its unit_price when there is no discounted_price), within a cent.
Verify the body's total equals subtotal minus additional_discount_amount minus eco_discount_amount, within a cent.

annotations.description: Known issue BUG-028: Stores a guest message under the user_id sent in the body, so it shows in that user's list, instead of leaving it without an owner.

specs.title: API-0350: Send a message as a guest returns 200 and an admin can read it

steps.title: Send POST /messages without an Authorization header, with a name, an email address, a unique subject and a message text, and take the body's id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's id is a non-empty string, its subject, message, name and email equal the values sent and its status is "NEW".
Verify the body has a created_at and no user_id key.
Verify GET /messages/{messageId} with that id and the admin's token returns 200 with the same subject and message, status "NEW" and user_id null.

specs.title: API-0352: Send a message with only a subject and a message returns 200

steps.title: Send POST /messages without an Authorization header, with a unique subject and a message text, without name and email, and take the body's id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's id is a non-empty string, its subject and message equal the values sent and its status is "NEW".
Verify GET /messages/{messageId} with that id and the admin's token returns 200 with the same subject and message, name null and email null.

specs.title: API-0353: Send a message with a 120-character subject and a 250-character message returns 200

steps.title: Send POST /messages without an Authorization header, with a 120-character subject and a 250-character message, and take the body's id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify GET /messages/{messageId} with that id and the admin's token returns 200 with the same subject and message.

specs.title: API-0354: Send a message with a status in the body ignores it and creates it as NEW

steps.title: Send POST /messages without an Authorization header, with a unique subject, a message text and status "RESOLVED", and take the body's id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's status is "NEW".
Verify GET /messages/{messageId} with that id and the admin's token returns 200 with status "NEW".

specs.title: API-0355: Send a message with a malformed token returns 200 and the message has no owner

steps.title: Send POST /messages with a malformed token, a unique subject and a message text, and take the body's id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body has no user_id key.
Verify GET /messages/{messageId} with that id and the admin's token returns 200 with user_id null.

specs.title: API-0392: Set a message's status without a token returns 401

steps.title: Send PUT /messages/{messageId}/status without an Authorization header, with a well-formed message id that doesn't exist and a body with status "RESOLVED".
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's message is "Unauthorized".

specs.title: API-0393: Set a message's status with a malformed token returns 401

steps.title: Send PUT /messages/{messageId}/status with a malformed token, a well-formed message id that doesn't exist and a body with status "RESOLVED".
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's message is "Unauthorized".

specs.title: API-0388: Set a message's status to RESOLVED returns 200 and the message shows it

steps.title: Send POST /messages without an Authorization header, with a unique subject and a message text, and take the new message's id.
Send PUT /messages/{messageId}/status with that id, the admin's token and a body with status "RESOLVED".
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify GET /messages/{messageId} with that id and the admin's token returns 200 with status "RESOLVED".

specs.title: API-0389: Set a message's status to IN_PROGRESS returns 200 and the message shows it

steps.title: Send POST /messages without an Authorization header, with a unique subject and a message text, and take the new message's id.
Send PUT /messages/{messageId}/status with that id, the admin's token and a body with status "IN_PROGRESS".
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify GET /messages/{messageId} with that id and the admin's token returns 200 with status "IN_PROGRESS".

specs.title: API-0390: Set a resolved message's status back to NEW returns 200

steps.title: Send POST /messages without an Authorization header, with a unique subject and a message text, and take the new message's id.
Send PUT /messages/{messageId}/status with that id, the admin's token and a body with status "RESOLVED".
Send PUT /messages/{messageId}/status with the same id, the admin's token and a body with status "NEW".
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify GET /messages/{messageId} with that id and the admin's token returns 200 with status "NEW".

specs.title: API-0391: Set a message's status to the status it already has returns 200

steps.title: Send POST /messages without an Authorization header, with a unique subject and a message text, and take the new message's id.
Send PUT /messages/{messageId}/status with that id, the admin's token and a body with status "NEW".
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify GET /messages/{messageId} with that id and the admin's token returns 200 with status "NEW".

specs.title: API-0394: Set the status of an unknown message id returns 404

steps.title: Send PUT /messages/{messageId}/status with a well-formed message id that doesn't exist, the admin's token and a body with status "RESOLVED".
Verify the response status is 404.
Verify the body's message is "Requested item not found".

specs.title: API-0395: Set a message's status without status returns 422 and keeps the status

steps.title: Send POST /messages without an Authorization header, with a unique subject and a message text, and take the new message's id.
Send PUT /messages/{messageId}/status with that id, the admin's token, an Accept header of application/json and an empty JSON object as the body.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body's errors has a status key with at least one message.
Verify GET /messages/{messageId} with that id and the admin's token returns 200 with status "NEW".

steps.title: Send POST /messages without an Authorization header, with a unique subject and a message text, and take the new message's id.

Verify the body's errors has a status key with at least one message.
Verify GET /messages/{messageId} with that id and the admin's token returns 200 with status "NEW".

specs.title: API-0397: Set a message's status to a lower-case value returns 422

steps.title: Send POST /messages without an Authorization header, with a unique subject and a message text, and take the new message's id.
Send PUT /messages/{messageId}/status with that id, the admin's token, an Accept header of application/json and a body with status "resolved".
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body's errors has a status key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0398: Set the status of an unknown message id with an invalid body returns 422, not 404

steps.title: Send PUT /messages/{messageId}/status with a well-formed message id that doesn't exist, the admin's token, an Accept header of application/json and an empty JSON object as the body.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body's errors has a status key with at least one message.

Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send POST /products/{productId}/specs with the new product's id, a body with a unique spec_name, spec_value "1.5" and spec_unit "kg", and the default user's token, and take the new spec's id.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body's product_id equals the new product's id.
Verify the body's spec_name, spec_value and spec_unit equal the sent values.
Verify the body's id is a non-empty string.
Verify GET /products/{productId}/specs with the new product's id returns a spec with that id and those spec_name, spec_value and spec_unit.

specs.title: API-0535: Add a spec without spec_unit returns spec_unit null

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.

Send POST /products/{productId}/specs with the new product's id, a body with a unique spec_name and spec_value "1.5" and no spec_unit, and the default user's token, and take the new spec's id.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body's spec_unit is null.
Verify GET /products/{productId}/specs/{specId} with the new product's id and the new spec's id returns spec_unit null.

annotations.description: Known issue BUG-032: Returns 200 with other customers' names, emails and cities instead of rejecting a customer (403, like GET /users).

specs.title: API-0406: Search users by first name returns 200 with the matching customer

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a unique first name of at most 40 characters, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send GET /users/search with q set to that first name and the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body has the keys current_page, data, from, last_page, per_page, to and total.
Verify the body's total is 1 and data has exactly one item, whose id is the new user's id and whose first_name and email equal the registered values.

specs.title: API-0407: Search users by email returns 200 with the matching customer

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send GET /users/search with q set to the registered email and the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's total is 1 and data has exactly one item, whose id is the new user's id.

specs.title: API-0408: Search users by last name returns 200 with the matching customer

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a unique last name of at most 20 characters and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send GET /users/search with q set to that last name and the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's total is 1 and data has exactly one item, whose id is the new user's id.

specs.title: API-0409: Search users by city returns 200 with the matching customer

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name, a random strong password and an address with only a unique city of at most 40 characters, and take the new user's id.
Send GET /users/search with q set to that city and the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's total is 1 and data has exactly one item, whose id is the new user's id.

specs.title: API-0410: Search users with a term nobody matches returns 200 with an empty list

steps.title: Send GET /users/search with q set to a unique string no customer has and the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's total is 0.
Verify the body's data is an empty array.

specs.title: API-0411: Search users without q returns 200 with customers

steps.title: Send GET /users/search without q and with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's per_page is 15 and data is not empty.
Verify every item's role is "user".

specs.title: API-0412: Search users with page 2 returns the second page

steps.title: Send GET /users/search with page 1 and the admin's token.
Send GET /users/search with page 2 and the admin's token.
Verify the first response's current_page is 1 and the second response's current_page is 2.
Verify no id appears in both pages' data.

specs.title: API-0404: List users without a token returns 401

steps.title: Send GET /users without an Authorization header.
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's message is "Unauthorized".

specs.title: API-0405: List users as a customer returns 403

steps.title: Send GET /users with the default user's token.
Verify the response status is 403.
Verify the body's message is "Forbidden".

specs.title: API-0402: List users as an admin returns 200 with a page of customers

steps.title: Send GET /users with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body has the keys current_page, data, from, last_page, per_page, to and total, and its per_page is 15.
Verify data has 1 to 15 items and every item's role is "user".

specs.title: API-0403: List users with page 2 returns the second page

steps.title: Send GET /users with page 1 and the admin's token.
Send GET /users with page 2 and the admin's token.
Verify the first response's current_page is 1 and the second response's current_page is 2.
Verify no id appears in both pages' data.

specs.title: API-0425: Patch user with the customer's own id and a new first_name returns 200 and changes only that field

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take its access_token.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with that id and access_token and only first_name set to a new value.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify GET /users/me with that access_token returns the new first_name and the registered last_name and email.

specs.title: API-0429: Patch user without a token returns 401

steps.title: Send PATCH /users/{userId} with a well-formed ULID that no user has and first_name set to a new value, without an Authorization header.
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's message is "Unauthorized".

specs.title: API-0430: Patch user with another customer's id returns 403 and leaves that customer unchanged

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password (customer A).
Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password (customer B), and take B's id.
Send POST /users/login with customer A's email and password, and take its access_token.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with customer B's id, customer A's access_token and first_name set to a new value.
Verify the response status is 403.
Verify the body's error is a non-empty string.
Send POST /users/login with customer B's email and password, and take its access_token.
Verify GET /users/me with B's access_token returns B's registered first_name.

specs.title: API-0431: Patch user with a phone containing letters returns 422 and leaves the profile unchanged

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name, a random strong password and a phone of digits, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take its access_token.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with that id, access_token and a phone containing letters.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a phone key with at least one message.
Verify GET /users/me with that access_token returns the registered phone.

specs.title: API-0432: Patch user with a dob under 18 years ago returns 422 and leaves the profile unchanged

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name, a random strong password and an adult dob, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take its access_token.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with that id, access_token and a dob 10 years ago in YYYY-MM-DD.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a dob key with at least one message.
Verify GET /users/me with that access_token returns the registered dob.

specs.title: API-0435: Patch user with an email another account uses returns 409 or 422

annotations.description: Known issue BUG-035: Returns 403, with the SQL error in the body, instead of 409 or 422 when the email already belongs to another account.

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password (customer A).
Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password (customer B).
Send POST /users/login with customer A's email and password, and take its access_token.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with customer A's id, A's access_token and email set to customer B's email.
Verify the response status is 409 or 422.

annotations.description: Known issue BUG-035: Returns 403, with the SQL error in the body, instead of 409 or 422 when the email already belongs to another account.

specs.title: API-0426: Patch user as an admin changes another user's last_name

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with the new user's id, the admin's token and only last_name set to a new value of at most 20 characters.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify GET /users/{userId} with the new user's id and the admin's token returns the new last_name and the registered first_name.

specs.title: API-0427: Patch user as an admin with enabled false disables the account

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with the new user's id, the admin's token and enabled false.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify GET /users/{userId} with the new user's id and the admin's token returns enabled false.

specs.title: API-0428: Patch user as an admin with a role key drops the role silently

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with the new user's id, the admin's token and role "admin".
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify GET /users/{userId} with the new user's id and the admin's token returns role "user".

specs.title: API-0290: Change password with a valid new password returns 200 and the new password logs in

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take the new access_token.
Send POST /users/change-password with that token, current_password set to that password, and new_password and new_password_confirmation both set to a different random strong password.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify POST /users/login with that email and the new password returns 200 with a non-empty access_token.

specs.title: API-0291: Change password without new_password returns 422

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take the new access_token.
Send POST /users/change-password with that token, current_password set to that password and new_password_confirmation set to a different random strong password, without new_password.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body's errors.new_password is a non-empty list.

specs.title: API-0292: Change password without new_password_confirmation returns 422

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take the new access_token.
Send POST /users/change-password with that token, current_password set to that password and new_password set to a different random strong password, without new_password_confirmation.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body's errors.new_password is a non-empty list.

specs.title: API-0293: Change password with a confirmation that doesn't match returns 422

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take the new access_token.

Send POST /users/change-password with that token, current_password set to that password, new_password set to a different random strong password and new_password_confirmation set to a third random strong password.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body's errors.new_password is a non-empty list.

specs.title: API-0294: Change password without current_password returns 400

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take the new access_token.
Send POST /users/change-password with that token, and new_password and new_password_confirmation both set to a different random strong password, without current_password.
Verify the response status is 400.
Verify the body's success is false.
Verify the body's message is "Your current password does not matches with the password.".

specs.title: API-0295: Change password with a wrong current password returns 400

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take the new access_token.

Send POST /users/change-password with that token, current_password set to a random strong password that isn't that user's password, and new_password and new_password_confirmation both set to another random strong password.
Verify the response status is 400.
Verify the body's success is false.
Verify the body's message is "Your current password does not matches with the password.".

specs.title: API-0296: Change password with the current password as the new one returns 400

steps.title: Send POST /users/change-password with the default user's token, and current_password, new_password and new_password_confirmation all set to the default user's password.
Verify the response status is 400.
Verify the body's success is false.
Verify the body's message is "New Password cannot be same as your current password.".

specs.title: API-0399: Forgot password for an existing email returns 200 and resets the password to welcome02

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/forgot-password with that email.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify POST /users/login with that email and the password "welcome02" returns 200 with a non-empty access_token.

specs.title: API-0400: Forgot password without email returns 404

steps.title: Send POST /users/forgot-password with an empty JSON object as the body.
Verify the response status is 404.
Verify the body's message is "Requested item not found".

specs.title: API-0401: Forgot password for an unknown email returns 422

steps.title: Send POST /users/forgot-password with a unique email that no account has.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body's errors.email is a non-empty list.

specs.title: API-0078: Login returns 200 with a bearer token

steps.title: Send POST /users/login with the default user's email and password.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's access_token is a non-empty string.
Verify the body's token_type is "bearer".
Verify the body's expires_in is 300.
Verify GET /users/me with the new access_token returns 200 with the default user's email.

specs.title: API-0079: Login with a wrong password returns 401

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and a different password.
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's error is "Unauthorized" or "Invalid login request".

specs.title: API-0080: Login with an email no account has returns 401

steps.title: Send POST /users/login with a unique email that no account has and a random strong password.
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's error is "Unauthorized" or "Invalid login request".

specs.title: API-0081: Login without credentials returns 401

steps.title: Send POST /users/login with an empty JSON object as the body.
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's error is "Unauthorized" or "Invalid login request".

specs.title: API-0082: TOTP login step with a full token returns 401

steps.title: Send POST /users/login with access_token set to the default user's token and any totp value.
Verify the response status is 401.

specs.title: API-0083: TOTP login step with an invalid access token returns 400

steps.title: Send POST /users/login with an access_token that isn't a valid token and any totp value.
Verify the response status is 400.
Verify the body's error is "Invalid or expired token".

specs.title: API-0308: Login of a TOTP account returns "TOTP required" with a restricted token

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take its access_token.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with that id, totp_enabled true and totp_secret set to a known base32 secret, with the customer's own access_token.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's message is "TOTP required" and requires_totp is true.
Verify the body's access_token is a non-empty string.
Verify the body has no token_type or expires_in key.

specs.title: API-0309: TOTP login step with the right code returns a full token

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take its access_token.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with that id, totp_enabled true and totp_secret set to a known base32 secret, with the customer's own access_token.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take the restricted access_token from the response.
Send POST /users/login with access_token set to the restricted access_token and totp set to the current 6-digit code for that secret.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's access_token is a non-empty string.
Verify the body's token_type is "bearer".
Verify GET /users/me with the new access_token returns 200 with the throwaway customer's email.

specs.title: API-0310: Restricted token of the TOTP first step is rejected as a session

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take its access_token.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with that id, totp_enabled true and totp_secret set to a known base32 secret, with the customer's own access_token.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take the restricted access_token from the response.
Send GET /users/me with the restricted access_token.
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's message is "Unauthorized token usage".

specs.title: API-0311: TOTP login step with a wrong code returns 401

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take its access_token.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with that id, totp_enabled true and totp_secret set to a known base32 secret, with the customer's own access_token.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take the restricted access_token from the response.
Send POST /users/login with access_token set to the restricted access_token and totp set to a 6-digit code that differs from the secret's codes for the current and the neighbouring 30-second periods.
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's error is "Invalid TOTP".
Verify the body has no access_token key.

specs.title: API-0084: Login to a disabled account returns 403

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send PATCH /users/{userId} with that id and enabled false, with the admin's token.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password.
Verify the response status is 403.
Verify the body's error is "Account disabled".

specs.title: API-0085: Register returns 201 with the new customer

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body has a non-empty id and a non-empty created_at.
Verify the body's first_name, last_name and email equal the values sent.
Verify the body has an address object.
Verify POST /users/login with that email and password returns 200, and GET /users/me with its access_token returns the new id and email.

specs.title: API-0086: Register stores the optional fields sent

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name, a random strong password, a phone of digits, a dob 30 years ago in YYYY-MM-DD, and an address with street, house_number, city, state and postal_code (no country).
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body's phone and dob equal the values sent.
Verify the body's address street, house_number, city, state and postal_code equal the values sent.
Verify POST /users/login with that email and password returns 200, and GET /users/me with its access_token returns the same phone, dob and address values.

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with an empty JSON object as the body.

specs.title: API-0092: Register with a subscript character in the first name returns 422

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name followed by a Unicode subscript character, a last name and a random strong password.

specs.title: API-0305: Register stores the country and a postal code in that country's format

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name, a random strong password, and an address with a street, a city, a state, country "NL" and postal_code "1011AB".
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body's address street, city, state, country and postal_code equal the values sent.
Verify POST /users/login with that email and password returns 200, and GET /users/me with its access_token returns the same address street, city, state, country and postal_code.
